content.name: Dimitri Papadakis
content.title: Head of PMO
content.summary: Head of PMO with 18 years in insurance IT, energy and telecoms, trained as a Dipl.-Ing. in electrical engineering at RWTH Aachen. Lead a PMO of nine at a Cologne pharmaceutical logistics company and oversee a €41m portfolio, including a GDP-compliant cold-chain warehouse delivered on time. PMP and IPMA Level B certified, used to working with works councils and international vendors.

experience.title: Head of PMO
bullets: Lead a PMO of nine project managers and controllers overseeing a €41m portfolio of 25 IT, automation and site projects.
Delivered a GDP-compliant cold-chain warehouse with automated storage on schedule, adding capacity for 18,000 pallets.
Introduced portfolio prioritisation with the executive board that stopped seven low-value projects and freed €3.2m.
Agreed a works agreement with the works council for the new warehouse management system before rollout.

experience.title: Senior Project Manager
bullets: Managed fibre-to-the-home rollout projects connecting 65,000 households in North Rhine-Westphalia.
Negotiated civil works contracts with eight subcontractors, keeping cost per connection 6% below plan.
Led a team of five project managers through the shift to remote working without schedule slippage.

experience.title: Project Manager
bullets: Ran substation modernisation and smart meter pilot projects worth up to €8m.
Coordinated grid operator, municipality and contractor approvals for 14 sites.
Built a risk register template that the engineering department adopted for all capital projects.

experience.title: Project Assistant, IT
bullets: Supported the migration of policy data centres, maintaining plans and status reports for 30 workstreams.
Organised steering committee meetings and tracked decisions and actions.
Took over a small server consolidation project as acting project manager in 2010.

courses.name: IPMA Level B (Certified Senior Project Manager)

achievements.title: Portfolio savings
achievements.detail: Freed €3.2m in the first year of portfolio prioritisation.

achievements.title: GPM speaker
achievements.detail: Presented on PMO maturity at a GPM regional group meeting in Köln (2023).
